children: AURA SYSTEMS INC reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $278K and a net loss of $10.9M, an improvement from a net loss of $21.1M in fiscal 2025 as the company shifted toward prototype-related sales and expanded R&D and engineering capabilities.
Revenue was $278K for fiscal 2026, up from $50K in fiscal 2025.
Net income: net loss of $10.9M for fiscal 2026, improved from a net loss of $21.1M in fiscal 2025.
Diluted earnings per share: not reported in the disclosed sections.
Revenue growth was driven by prototype-related sales activity as the company transitions from legacy products toward prototype production and commercialization of axial flux induction platforms.
Sales remain primarily direct in North America, with agents and distributors handling international markets; management is exploring licensing and joint venture opportunities.

Product development milestones include completed designs for multiple motor/generator models: 1.5, 3.75, 10 and a second-generation 250 kW axial flux induction platform, plus designs for 50 kW and a 5 kW military variant.
R&D and engineering buildout: the company expanded its engineering team with Ph.D. and M.S. hires and invested approximately $1.6M in R&D and advanced design tools in fiscal 2026.
